linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Linked, Non- Participating Individual, Pure Risk Premium/ Savings, Life/Health Insurance Rider

attached_to_ulips.note: Linked from the product pages of these three ULIPs. The brochure also lists Sampoorn Nivesh Plus, Smart Protect Plus and Click to Invest Plus as available base products.

waiver_of_premium.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
waiver_of_premium.quote: Comprehensive protection against death, terminal illness and disability.
waiver_of_premium.note: Options are death cover, accidental death, personal accident and daily hospital cash.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: Comprehensive protection against death, terminal illness and disability.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: Comprehensive protection against death, terminal illness and disability.

critical_illness.value: No critical illness benefit. Terminal illness acceleration of the death cover is paid for a life assured up to age 80, capped at Rs 2 crore.
critical_illness.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
critical_illness.quote: the maximum amount of Rider Sum Assured that can be accelerated under this benefit is Rs 2 crore

accidental_death.value: Option B: accidental death, lump sum of the highest of the rider sum assured, 7 times the annualised rider premium (1.25 times for single pay) or 105% of rider premiums paid. Option C also pays accidental death. Can be paid as monthly income for 10 years.
accidental_death.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
accidental_death.quote: Rider Sum Assured for Option B shall be a lump sum benefit which is the highest of:

accidental_disability.value: Option C, personal accident cover: monthly income of 1% of rider sum assured for 10 years on accidental total permanent disability; accidental partial permanent disability pays scheduled percentages (50% for loss of a hand or foot).
accidental_disability.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
accidental_disability.quote: a regular monthly benefit equal to 1% of Rider Sum Assured, is payable to the Life Assured for

term_cover.value: Option A, death cover: on death of the life assured, the highest of the rider sum assured, 10 times the annualised rider premium (1.25 times for single pay) or 105% of total rider premiums paid. Return of premium option available. Includes terminal illness acceleration.
term_cover.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
term_cover.quote: The death benefit is highest of

hospital_cash.value: Option D, daily hospitalisation cash and surgical care: 1% of rider sum assured a day (2% in ICU), up to 20 days a policy year and 100 days in total, plus surgical care benefit up to 100% of rider sum assured.
hospital_cash.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
hospital_cash.quote: Hospitalization Benefit (Non-ICU): Benefit amount shall be equal to 1% of the Rider Sum Assured

other.value: Wellness benefits worth 100% of the annual rider premium, redeemable only through the Life Rewards app (OPD consultations, preventive health check-up, tele consultation, healthy living program). Double benefit if an accident happens in listed circumstances.
other.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
other.quote: Get double payout in case of accident occurs under listed circumstances with Double

rider_term.value: Minimum 5 years. Maximum for options A, B and C: the outstanding policy term of the base policy. Option D: 5 years.
rider_term.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited or regular pay (the 10 times and 1.25 times multiples in the benefit formulas refer to limited or regular and single pay). Opted at inception or on any premium due date of the base plan.
premium_paying_rules.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
premium_paying_rules.quote: This rider can be opted at inception or subsequently on any premium due date of the base plan

entry_age.value: 18 to 65 years; maturity age 23 minimum; maximum 85 (option A), 75 (options B and C), 70 (option D)
entry_age.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 10,000 for options A, B and C; Rs 1,00,000 for option D. Maximum: up to the base policy sum assured for options A, C and D; up to three times the base policy sum assured for option B. Subject to board-approved underwriting.

premium_deduction.value: Separate rider premium, payable along with the base premium. The brochure does not say the premium comes out of the fund.
premium_deduction.doc: HDFC Life Livewell Rider linked Brochure (product page link)
premium_deduction.quote: as long as the premium due is paid along with the base premium
premium_deduction.note: No sentence on fund deduction found.
